arguments.sql:
SELECT quote(t.k_symbol) AS stored_purpose, COUNT(*) AS transactions
FROM main.trans AS t
WHERE t.amount > 4000
  AND t.account_id IN (
      SELECT d.account_id
      FROM main.disp AS d
      JOIN main.client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
      WHERE c.gender = 'M'
        AND c.birth_date >= '1974-01-01'
        AND c.birth_date < '1977-01-01'
  )
GROUP BY t.k_symbol

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS household_payments,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS other_purpose_payments
FROM main.trans AS t
WHERE t.amount > 4000
  AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> ''
  AND t.account_id IN (
      SELECT d.account_id
      FROM main.disp AS d
      JOIN main.client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
      WHERE c.gender = 'M'
        AND c.birth_date >= '1974-01-01'
        AND c.birth_date < '1977-01-01'
  )
LIMIT 1
